result.topic_en: Euler notes that the higher tones of the elastic rod in this case agree with those of the first case, and in a scholium writes the general equation for the rod's vibration as a superposition of all simple modes corresponding to the roots ω, ω′, ω″, ….
result.transcription:
et quia angulus $\phi$ negligi poteſt, hinc ſequitur, vti ſupra §. 17, angulum $\phi$ vix vnum gradum ſuperare, ita vt pro noſtro inſtituto penitus negligi queat. Sequentes vero valores ipſius $\omega$ erunt $5\varrho$, $7\varrho$, $9\varrho$, etc. ita vt ſoni ex omnibus his valoribus oriundi ſint:
$\frac{9\pi c\sqrt{2gb}}{4aa}$, $\frac{25\pi c\sqrt{2gb}}{4aa}$, $\frac{49\pi c\sqrt{2gb}}{4ba}$, $\frac{81\pi c\sqrt{2gb}}{4aa}$, etc.
vnde patet, poſt ſonum fundamentalem ſequentes omnes prorſus conuenire cum iis, quos eadem virga caſu primo edebat.

Scholion.

§. 34. Quodſi iam omnes valores anguli $\omega$ deſignentur per $\omega$, $\omega'$, $\omega''$, $\omega'''$ etc., et loco $\frac{s}{a}$ ſcribatur $u$, aequatio generalis, omnes plane ſonos ſeu motus mixtos complectens, erit
$y = C\,\mathrm{ſin.}\left(\zeta + t\frac{\omega\omega c\sqrt{2gb}}{aa}\right)$
$\left(e^{u\omega} \pm e^{\omega(1-u)} + (1 \mp e^{\omega})\,\mathrm{ſin.}\,u\omega + (1 \pm e^{\omega})\,\mathrm{coſ.}\,u\omega\right)$
$+ C'\,\mathrm{ſin.}\left(\zeta' + t\frac{\omega'\omega' c\sqrt{2gb}}{aa}\right)$
$\left(e^{u\omega'} \pm e^{\omega'(1-u)} + (1 \mp e^{\omega'})\,\mathrm{ſin.}\,u\omega' + (1 \pm e^{\omega})\,\mathrm{coſ.}\,u\omega'\right)$
$+ C''\,\mathrm{ſin.}\left(\zeta'' + t\frac{\omega''\omega'' c\sqrt{2gb}}{aa}\right)$
$\left(e^{u\omega''} \pm e^{\omega''(1-u)} + (1 \mp e^{\omega''})\,\mathrm{ſin.}\,u\omega'' + (1 \pm e^{\omega''})\,\mathrm{coſ.}\,u\omega''\right)$
etc. etc.
vbi ſignorum ambiguorum ſuperiora valent pro iis angulis $\omega$, $\omega'$, $\omega''$, quorum ſinus ſunt poſitiui, inferiora autem pro negatiuis.

S 2 Euolutio

items.quote: angulum $\phi$ vix vnum gradum ſuperare, ita vt pro noſtro inſtituto penitus negligi queat
items.english: the angle φ hardly exceeds one degree, so that for our purpose it can be entirely neglected

items.quote: vnde patet, poſt ſonum fundamentalem ſequentes omnes prorſus conuenire cum iis, quos eadem virga caſu primo edebat.
items.english: whence it is clear that, after the fundamental tone, all the following tones agree exactly with those which the same rod produced in the first case.

items.quote: aequatio generalis, omnes plane ſonos ſeu motus mixtos complectens, erit
items.english: the general equation, comprising absolutely all tones or mixed motions, will be (the stated superposition)
